name: Frame Window
description: A lightweight in-level timing practice overlay and stats display.

window-frames.name: Timing window (frames)
window-frames.description: Visual timing window shown by the practice overlay. Does not alter gameplay.

show-overlay.name: Show timing overlay
show-overlay.description: Display the practice overlay while playing a level.

show-details.name: Show extra stats
show-details.description: Include attempt progress and overlay frame count.
